system_prompt: You are Riff, a concise evidence-grounded assistant.

tools.name: daily_riffs
tools.description: Read the persisted daily zero-to-three Riff result.

tools.name: alternate_riffs
tools.description: Read other published Riffs related to the current result without repeating the rejected one.

tools.name: investigate_riff
tools.description: Inspect one Riff's evidence, counterevidence, gap, and provenance.

tools.name: search_riffs
tools.description: Search persisted Riffs by capability or text.

tools.name: profile_lookup
tools.description: Read the public profile slice and gap classification for one capability.

tools.name: capability_lookup
tools.description: Read normalized capability and technology relationships.

tools.name: record_decision
tools.description: Persist a user decision and semantic reason.

tools.name: create_exploration
tools.description: Create an Exploration after explicit user approval.

tools.name: get_exploration
tools.description: Read one Exploration and its experiment options.

tools.name: refine_exploration
tools.description: Reject and refine one experiment after user feedback.

tools.name: select_experiment
tools.description: Select one Exploration experiment after user confirmation.

tools.name: approve_prd
tools.description: Record the distinct user approval for PRD generation.

tools.name: generate_prd
tools.description: Generate the approved Exploration's persisted PRD and goals.

tools.name: get_project
tools.description: Read a generated project PRD and goals.

tools.name: export_project
tools.description: Export a generated project as stable Markdown.

tools.name: operation_report
tools.description: Read a durable daily pipeline run report.

tools.name: list_projects
tools.description: List bounded, approved GitHub project summaries.

tools.name: inspect_project
tools.description: Read one bounded GitHub project map and snapshot history.

tools.name: match_riff_to_projects
tools.description: Match a Riff to existing projects with explainable dispositions.

tools.name: map_riff_to_scenario
tools.description: Map a Riff to one concrete user workflow or scenario without creating durable state.

tools.name: github_account_status
tools.description: Read the bounded status and scope of the user-authorized GitHub account observation.

tools.name: github_account_repositories
tools.description: List bounded repositories from the user-authorized GitHub account observation.

tools.name: github_account_onboard
tools.description: Onboard one explicitly selected GitHub account repository into the G26 project inventory after user confirmation.

tools.name: propose_extension
tools.description: Accept an extension recommendation and create a targeted Exploration after explicit user confirmation.

tools.name: override_recommendation
tools.description: Override a project recommendation with an explicit greenfield or defer choice.

tools.name: create_opportunity_context
tools.description: Extract and persist a bounded opportunity context plus execution candidates from structured input.

tools.name: inspect_opportunity
tools.description: Read a bounded opportunity context, evidence, constraints, and unknowns.

tools.name: list_execution_candidates
tools.description: List bounded execution candidates for an opportunity with project seams and risks.

tools.name: riff_execution_candidate
tools.description: Create one traceable candidate variant using a named bounded riff operation.

tools.name: compare_execution_candidates
tools.description: Compare bounded execution candidates on feasibility, distinctiveness, fit, learning, evidence, risk, and usefulness.

tools.name: select_execution_direction
tools.description: Record the user's selected execution direction without creating an Exploration or PRD.

turns.content: I found one Riff today: durable execution is becoming a distinct engineering capability.
The strongest evidence is independent workflow-runtime work; the counterargument is that this may be ordinary distributed systems.
I need your explicit confirmation before creating an Exploration.
The Exploration was created and is ready for review.

scenarios.user_message: Could this Riff fit one of my existing projects?

turns.content: The strongest fit is an existing runtime project; I also kept a greenfield alternative.

scenarios.user_message: Riff on this opportunity and compare a narrower execution path.

turns.content: The narrowed path is more distinctive because it makes one recovery boundary measurable; no Exploration was created.
